attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Ohio Commercial Activity Tax (CAT) return. Checks for physical presence, economic nexus, or Ohio registration. Ohio CAT nexus: Physical presence (bright-line), Economic nexus ($500K Ohio receipts), or Ohio registration. No tax due threshold: $150K Ohio-sourced gross receipts.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in Ohio (bright-line presence)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq apportionment.state_code "OH" streq and

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets Ohio economic nexus threshold ($500K Ohio receipts)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.state_code "OH" streq and

action_details.action_comment: Physical presence but below exclusion threshold - no tax due
action_details.action_description: Set no CAT due and zero tax
action_details.action_postfix: // Physical presence but below threshold - no CAT due result.oh_qualifies_for_no_cat true xdef result.oh_cat_tax 0.0 xdef apportionment.state_tax 0.0 xdef

action_details.action_comment: Physical nexus established - CAT calculation required
action_details.action_description: Mark CAT as due and log bright-line presence
action_details.action_postfix: // Physical nexus - CAT calculation required result.oh_qualifies_for_no_cat false xdef

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established - CAT calculation required
action_details.action_description: Mark CAT as due and log economic nexus
action_details.action_postfix: // Economic nexus - CAT calculation required result.oh_qualifies_for_no_cat false xdef

action_details.action_description: Set no CAT due, zero tax, and refund any payments
action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus - no filing required result.oh_qualifies_for_no_cat true xdef result.oh_cat_tax 0.0 xdef apportionment.state_tax 0.0 xdef apportionment.state_refund_or_owed apportionment.state_payments xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Ohio taxable gross receipts for CAT. Applies situsing rules to determine Ohio-sourced receipts and subtracts excluded receipts. Process: (1) Total gross receipts, (2) Apply situsing rules for OH portion, (3) Subtract excluded receipts, (4) Result is OH taxable gross receipts subject to CAT. Common exclusions: federal government sales, affiliate transactions, interest/dividends, previously taxed receipts.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus and above exclusion threshold
Has receipts excluded from CAT calculation

action_details.action_comment: No nexus or below threshold - no calculation needed
action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus or below threshold - no calculation needed result.oh_taxable_gross_receipts 0.0 xdef
// Calculate gross receipts after exclusions result.oh_taxable_gross_receipts result.oh_cat_excluded_receipts sub 0.0 max /result.oh_taxable_gross_receipts xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Ohio Commercial Activity Tax (CAT) liability. Applies $150 minimum or 0.26% rate based on gross receipts. Tax structure: Receipts below $150K=No tax, $150K-$999,999=$150 minimum, $1M+=$150 minimum + 0.26% on receipts over $1M. Formula: CAT = $150 + (Taxable Receipts - $1M) × 0.0026. IMPORTANT: CAT has NO credits, purely based on gross receipts.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus and above exclusion threshold
Ohio receipts at or above $1M (subject to percentage tax)

action_details.action_comment: No nexus or below exclusion threshold - no CAT
action_details.action_description: Set zero tax and refund payments
action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus or below exclusion threshold - no CAT result.oh_cat_tax 0.0 xdef apportionment.state_tax 0.0 xdef apportionment.state_refund_or_owed apportionment.state_payments xdef

action_details.action_comment: Receipts over $1M - calculate percentage tax + minimum
action_details.action_postfix:
// Receipts over $1M - CAT = $150 + (Receipts - $1M) x 0.26% result.oh_taxable_gross_receipts result.oh_cat_minimum_threshold sub result.oh_cat_rate mul result.oh_cat_minimum_tax add /result.oh_cat_tax xdef
apportionment.state_tax result.oh_cat_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_comment: Receipts between $150K and $1M - minimum tax only
action_details.action_postfix: // Receipts between $150K and $1M - minimum tax only ($150) result.oh_cat_tax result.oh_cat_minimum_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax result.oh_cat_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_description: Set zero tax and refund payments
action_details.action_postfix: // No taxable receipts - no CAT result.oh_cat_tax 0.0 xdef apportionment.state_tax 0.0 xdef apportionment.state_refund_or_owed apportionment.state_payments xdef
